description: One job a scheduler has to fit into run windows: what it is, how many units it needs and where it currently sits. The record is a VALUE: the host recomposes it with run with { … }, and no component mutates the instance it was given. Id is the identity the plan and the reader's own placement are keyed by, so a blank id is REJECTED at construction. Segments is what the HOST has already committed: the planner reads the first segment's window as the run's preferred start window, which is how "move this run to Thursday" survives a round-trip. The component recomputes the actual placement from EstimatedUnits over the windows it was given, so the plan it draws can never disagree with the capacity bars next to it. An empty list means "no preference — first fit".

members.name: EstimatedUnits
members.description: How much work the run needs, in abstract units the windows also count in. Zero (the default) means the run needs no capacity; a negative value reads as zero.

members.name: HasKnownStatus
members.description: Whether Status is one of the declared states (a cast integer may not be).

members.name: HasSegments
members.description: Whether the host supplied a placement.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable identity of the run. Never empty: construction rejects a blank value.

members.name: IsPaused
members.description: Whether the run is deliberately not scheduled for now.

members.name: IsRunning
members.description: Whether the run is running right now.

members.name: IsSettled
members.description: Whether the run is finished (succeeded or failed) and no longer competes for attention.

members.name: NeedsCapacity
members.description: Whether the run needs any capacity at all.

members.name: PlannedUnits
members.description: The units the plan has to place: the host's value, never below zero.

members.name: Segments
members.description: The placement the host committed, or an empty list. Its FIRST segment's window is the run's preferred start window; the rest is informational (the planner recomputes the slices so they add up to the capacity it draws).

members.name: Status
members.description: How the run is doing. Default Planned: an unclassified run is planned work, never a finished one.

members.name: Title
members.description: The run in the host's own words. A whitespace-only title reads as empty.
